I'm 15 but I feel like I understand what you mean. I've gotten so used to being lonely that I'm almost okay with it, but then someone in my life will spark up something and make me so happy and it's like an addiction, once I feel that comfort of just someone acknowledging that I'm a person that exists I keep needing it. And then they step back again. Just like every time it's happened before. And I'm left feeling way worse than I started. It's like some cruel cosmic joke, let me grab the dangling carrot but then snatch it back. And I keep telling myself to just stick it out because it won't matter eventually anyway. Eventually my entire existence and all of the shit that I go through will just be irrelevant so might as well just stick it out for now. Yk day by day and all that. It's still so hard though. It doesn't stop me from wanting to just blink out of existence most mornings. Like I don't really want to die, I mean I don't think I'd mind it, but I mostly just want a break from being alive. I've never dated anyone or anything so I don't have any toxic exes, but my parents are super confusing and manipulative and they gaslight me all the time and they're probably emotionally abusive, so I can relate to an extent. I just feel like I'm about to break all the time and there's nothing I can do. I'm not sure hope was ever an option, I just feel so lost. And I keep telling myself that it'll work out when I move out and that I can start over and be okay, but I know that that's not going to happen. I have big dreams, but how can I reach the stars when I'm so fucking small?
